title: Run a PM and a coder
tagline: Two agents, one reviewing the other, working on their own for hours.
outcomes: Write a PM brief that holds a coder to a clear idea of done
Start a pair on a real task
Check in without getting in the way
Notice when a pair is going in circles, and fix it

quiz.question: The coder says a piece is done. What does the PM do?
options: Fixes anything it doesn't like in the code itself
Checks it against the list of what done means, and sends it back with specifics if it falls short
quiz.why: The PM reviews against the checks it wrote at the start. It doesn't write code, and it only asks you what it can't decide.

quiz.question: Two hours in, nothing has passed review and the PM keeps asking for more. What's the likely cause?
options: The checks are vague, so nothing can pass them
The PM needs a bigger model
quiz.why: A loop that doesn't finish almost always means the checks can't be met. Tighten them so each one is something anyone could verify.
